Type: rug
Name: Stone & Beam Contemporary Speckle Wool Area Rug, 5' x 7' 6", Chestnut
Colors: Chestnut
Materials: wool
100% Wool Imported Gradated tones of chestnut give this rug a beautiful texture and a calming feel. Hand-tufted of 100% wool, this contemporary rug is durable and ready to blend with your existing styles. Transitional style Hand-tufted in India of 100% wool Timeless look with durability for high-traffic areas 5' x 7'6" Pairs with a rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow a few days for natural fibers to settle.
